# Bloub engine attribution

- Source: https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub
- Commit: `b4bb3c1b5f93c7b87a2e8d620f667c4093d97749`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.bloub`.
- Adaptation: the framework-free TypeScript modules under upstream `src/bot/`
  are bundled as browser ESM. Hermes supplies a React SVG renderer and maps
  acknowledged conversation states to upstream animation states. The measured
  engine constants and `engine.sample(t)` behavior are unchanged.

The upstream project states that it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or
connected to x.ai. Its license covers the code, not the design it imitates.
